payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including data augmentation techniques and subword segmentation.

claims.text: Data augmentation methods such as Back Translation and Mix-Source are used to generate synthetic data from monolingual corpora, which helps alleviate data sparsity.
Subword segmentation techniques like Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) and its variant VNBPE are employed to reduce vocabulary size and improve translation quality with less data.
Segmenting words into sub-components allows NMT to learn translations with considerably fewer data, thus addressing data sparsity.
